title: Add Sunburst Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: The radial partition layout is a native Vega transform (`stratify` + `partition`), and the resulting depth/angle values map onto arc marks the same way Donut already does (getDonutMark's theta/innerRadius/outerRadius pattern is directly reusable). The genuinely new pieces are zoomable drill-down re-rooting a radial layout (distinct from Treemap's rectangular re-root) and a center hub button — both well-defined once designed, building on the hierarchy-repair groundwork shared with add-tree-mark and the arc-geometry groundwork shared with Donut, so remaining research is narrow despite three subsystems being combined.

summary: An id/parent/value/label hierarchy mark rendering a radial (icicle-style) partition layout as nested arcs (Vega's `stratify` + `partition` transforms, reusing Donut's arc-mark geometry), with zoomable drill-down, a center hub button to zoom back out, and an angle-sweep enter animation matching Donut.
requirements: Accepts `id`, `parent`, `value` (required) and an optional `label` channel; reuses the same auto-repair-flat-hierarchy groundwork as the Tree mark for malformed data

Renders a radial partition layout via Vega's `stratify` + `partition` transforms, converting each node's layout position into arc theta/innerRadius/outerRadius values the same way Donut's arc mark is built
Clicking a ring segment zooms in, re-rooting the radial layout at that node's subtree (its ring becomes the new inner ring)
A center hub button zooms back out one level, reversing the most recent drill-down
Arcs animate in with an angle-sweep enter transition, reusing Donut's existing sweep animation pattern

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Auto-repair synthesizes a root, reusing the same hierarchyUtils.ts logic as Tree.

edgeCases.case: Clicking a leaf ring segment with no children
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: No-op — zoom-in only applies to nodes that have descendants.

edgeCases.case: Clicking the center hub at the top-level (already at root)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: No-op / hub should be visually inert (e.g. no hover affordance) when there's nothing to zoom out to.

edgeCases.case: A node's value is zero or missing
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Renders as a zero-angle arc (invisible but present in the layout) rather than throwing.

edgeCases.case: Many siblings at one depth level (thin arc slices)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Label rendering should suppress below an angle threshold, matching the same in-slice label rule Donut/Pie already use.
Arc colors resolve through the existing colorScheme-aware color scale.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.

crossCutting.notes: touchesHoverAnimation: reuses Donut's existing angle-sweep enter-animation encode from donutUtils.ts, applied per-arc across all depth levels rather than one ring. touchesTooltipOrPopover: arcs support ChartTooltip/ChartPopover showing label/value, reusing existing interactive-mark plumbing. requiresNewSignalOrScale: true — a `zoomRoot` signal (set on segment click, cleared/popped by the center hub click, following a stack so the hub can unwind multiple levels) driving the partition transform's root and the arc radius scale's domain. requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.

implementationPlan.change: Create SunburstOptions/SunburstOptionsWithDefaults/SunburstSpecOptions with required `id`/`parent`/`value` fields and an optional `label` field.
Add SunburstOptions to the MarkOptions union.
Fully-populated defaultSunburstOptions fixture, reusing the tree mark's malformed-hierarchy fixture pattern.

addStratifyAndPartitionTransforms (Vega `stratify` + `partition` transform pair scoped to the current zoomRoot signal), addArcAnglesFromPartition (maps partition layout output (y0/y1/x0/x1) onto theta0/theta1/innerRadius/outerRadius fields, reusing the angle-mapping approach from donutUtils.ts) — reuses tree/hierarchyUtils.ts's repairFlatHierarchy from add-tree-mark rather than duplicating it.
getSunburstArcMark, reusing donutUtils.ts's getDonutMark arc construction and angle-sweep animation encode, driven by the mapped theta/radius fields instead of a single-ring domain.

addSunburst, addData (calls repairFlatHierarchy + the new transform/mapping helpers), addSignals (zoomRoot stack signal with click/hub handlers, plus interactive-mark signals), setScales (categorical color scale).
Unit tests for the transform and angle-mapping helpers, including the zoomRoot-scoping behavior.
Unit tests for getSunburstArcMark using the fixture.
Register sunburstCount: -1 in initializeComponentCounts, import addSunburst, add the 'sunburst' switch case.
SunburstProps/SunburstElement, Omit-ing only fields replaced at the React boundary (ChartTooltip/ChartPopover children).
Render-null component holding prop defaults, placed under rc/ per the Donut/BigNumber rc-status precedent.
Import Sunburst from '../rc' and add its displayName dispatch case.
Add Sunburst to the sanitizeRscChartChildren import/list from '../rc'.
Update the toStrictEqual ChartOptions snapshot to include the new mark type at default values.
Basic story plus a ZoomDrillDown interaction story showing the center hub button.

openQuestions: Is the center hub rendered as part of the Sunburst mark's own group (an inner circle mark with a click handler) or a separate chart-level element the consumer places? Mirrors the same open question in add-treemap-mark's back button.
Should ring depth be visually capped (e.g. only render N levels at once from the current zoomRoot) to avoid arbitrarily thin outer rings on very deep hierarchies?
